theme: Phase 3 — Live calibration loop. Bridge from existing journal (verdict_log + outcome_log) into the v3.9 calibration registry.

newOptionalFields: VerdictRecord.calibrationContext (audit field; optional for backwards compat)
compatibility.behaviorChange: VERSION constant bumped from 3.5.6 → 3.10.0. New journal lines tagged 3.10.0. Pre-v3.10 journal lines remain readable; they just lack the calibrationContext field.

changedFiles.reason: Bridge module. Joins verdict_log + outcome_log by verdictId, picks latest outcome per verdict (preferring terminal), maps TP/SL/EXPIRED → WIN/LOSS/TIMEOUT, returns BacktestVerdictRecord[].
New --from-journal mode (single-symbol or all). Reuses buildCalibrationFromRecords from v3.9 — no duplicate logic. Honest skip stats reported.
Adds VerdictCalibrationContext type and optional calibrationContext field on VerdictRecord. Lets the journal record exactly which bin produced each verdict's confidence.
buildRecord() reads pair.scores.calibration (set in v3.9 court.ts) and folds into log line. Resilient to missing fields.
VERSION constant bumped to 3.10.0. New journal lines carry this version tag.
Real unit test: writes 228-verdict fixture journal, runs bridge, asserts 60.0%/75.0% win-rates recovered exactly + correct skip counts.
Version 3.10.0. test:calibration-journal script added to default test pipeline.
Full documentation of the live calibration loop and production workflow.

verification.smokeTest: PASSED — buildRecordsFromJournal recovered seeded fixture exactly: bin 25-40 (100 trades, 60 wins, 40 losses, 60.0%); bin 40-55 (100 trades, 75 wins, 25 losses, 75.0%); bin 0-15 (10 WAIT, 0 trades); skipped: 10 still_open + 5 fetch_failed
verification.endToEndCli: PASSED — `npm run calibrate -- --from-journal --pair EURUSD` ingested fixture journal and updated registry to 60.0%/75.0%

knownLimitations: MIN_BIN_SAMPLE_SIZE=20 still applies — sparse bins continue using heuristic.
Tracker latency: outcome enters calibration only after marked terminal (≤24h for day-trades via EXPIRED if SL/TP not hit).
outcomeBars not recorded by tracker (only outcomePips); calibration math doesn't need it but it's null in journal-derived records.
Filesystem-based journal (./data/*.jsonl). Cloudflare Workers KV/D1 adapter is future work.
deferredToNextRound: Continuous nightly refresh + feature flag for 'live calibration auto-update' vs 'pin to deploy'
Tier-threshold re-tuning from observed win-rate distributions (after ~6mo of live data)
Phase 2B/2C: historical news/calendar archives for richer backtest cold-start (now lower priority since live data takes over)
